title: 3.4.2.1 Oneplus 9 rooted LineageOS Omnipod Dash Found too many pods for activation
symptom: While activating a new Omnipod Dash for the first time on AAPS v3.4.2.1 (self compiled) on my daughters phone I repeatedly got this error: `pump/omnipod/dash/src/main/res/values/strings.xml:32:    <string name="omnipod_dash_found_too_many_pods">Found too many pods for activation</string>`
evidence_quote: I was not able to reproduce the problem tonight under the same circumstances. Everything worked fine, so I don't know what the cause was.
